title: Anthropic defied the odds in its record IPO. Now it has to reckon with AI market turbulence
summary: Anthropic faced a market sell-off, raging anti-AI sentiment and a crisis at Nvidia in pulling off the largest IPO on record.
title_en: Anthropic Pulls Off Record IPO Despite Market Sell-Off and AI Backlash
title_zh: Anthropic逆势完成史上最大IPO，直面AI市场动荡
summary_en: Anthropic completed the largest IPO on record despite a market sell-off, anti-AI sentiment and a crisis at Nvidia, and now faces turbulence in the AI market.
summary_zh: Anthropic在市场抛售、反AI情绪及英伟达危机中完成史上最大IPO，如今需应对AI市场动荡。

title: Nasdaq erases all 2026 gains as AI sell-off dampens Anthropic’s second day of trading
summary: The Nasdaq lost trillions in value, with the AI startup’s IPO failing to buoy it as investors question huge sums being poured into AI buildout Who are Anthropic’s seven co-founders, now worth $180bn? As Anthropic’s stock dropped during its second day of trading, the wider stock market dipped with it. On Friday, the Nasdaq Composite erased all its gains for 2026 and closed down 5% from its value on 1 January. The Dow Jones Industrial Average and S&P 500 closed in correction territory. Anthropic’s record-breaking IPO failed to stem a global sell-off in AI-linked companies, and the tech-heavy Nasdaq erased some $4tn in market value this week, according to the Wall Street Journal. Continue reading...
title_en: Nasdaq Erases All 2026 Gains as AI Sell-Off Dampens Anthropic's Second Trading Day
title_zh: AI抛售拖累Anthropic上市次日，纳斯达克回吐2026年全部涨幅
summary_en: The Nasdaq erased all 2026 gains and closed down 5% as Anthropic's record IPO failed to halt a global AI sell-off, wiping about $4tn in market value this week.
summary_zh: 纳斯达克回吐2026年全部涨幅并收跌5%，Anthropic创纪录IPO未能阻止全球AI抛售潮，本周市值蒸发约4万亿美元。

title: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann Hypothesis — and a human did, too
summary: Mathematicians are having their minds blown by the latest AI-driven result — and there's a competing human solution, too.
title_en: AI and Human Both Claim Solutions to the 167-Year-Old Riemann Hypothesis
title_zh: AI与人类同时宣称破解167年历史的黎曼猜想
summary_en: Mathematicians are stunned as an AI system and a human researcher each claim to have solved the Riemann Hypothesis, a 167-year-old problem. The competing solutions are now under scrutiny.
summary_zh: 数学界震惊：一个AI系统与一位人类研究者各自宣称解决了167年未解的黎曼猜想，两项竞争性证明正接受审查。

title: Is Claude creator Anthropic really worth $1.3 trillion? - The Latest
summary: The AI firm and Claude chatbot maker Anthropic has made a historic stock market debut, with a peak valuation of $1.3tn on its first day of trading. It marks a remarkable ascent for a start-up launched in just 2021 by a group of ex-OpenAI staffers. Anthropic’s CEO, Dario Amodei, said the record-breaking IPO had ‘strengthened’ the company’s resolve to ‘do the right thing’. Despite the excitement, the Guardian’s head of business John Collingridge tells Lucy Hough that there are still challenges ahead for the global AI industry Continue reading...
title_en: Anthropic Hits $1.3 Trillion Valuation in Record IPO Debut

summary_en: Anthropic, maker of Claude and founded by ex-OpenAI staff in 2021, debuted on the stock market with a peak valuation of $1.3 trillion, a record-breaking IPO. CEO Dario Amodei says it strengthened the company's resolve, though challenges remain for the AI industry.
summary_zh: Claude开发商Anthropic由前OpenAI员工于2021年创立，上市首日峰值估值达1.3万亿美元，创下纪录。CEO达里奥·阿莫代伊称这坚定了公司信念，但全球AI行业仍面临挑战。

title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude

If verified, it would mark yet another seismic achievement for AI in mathematics and add to the upheaval […]

title: Anthropic falls nearly 9% in first full day of trading as tech stocks get shellacked
summary: Anthropic opened at $111.50 per share on Thursday, but closed at $97.17, which was 17% above the $83 IPO price.
title_en: Anthropic Falls Nearly 9% in First Full Trading Day as Tech Stocks Slide
title_zh: Anthropic上市首日完整交易日下跌近9%，科技股遭重挫
summary_en: Anthropic opened at $111.50 on Thursday but closed at $97.17, down nearly 9% for the day though still 17% above its $83 IPO price, as tech stocks broadly sold off.
summary_zh: Anthropic周四开盘报111.50美元，收盘97.17美元，当日下跌近9%，但仍较83美元的IPO发行价高出17%，科技股整体遭抛售。

title: Trump threatens ban on US firms building AI data centres overseas

summary_zh: 一名研究员在提示词中植入200万个可追踪的独特秘密，证明数据在AI供应链中流转时无法保持私密。

title: The most misunderstood graph in AI just got a major update

The report is an update to the organization’s time horizon plot, which was widely…

title_zh: METR更新被广泛误读的AI能力图表
summary_en: AI evaluation nonprofit METR has updated its widely misunderstood time horizon plot. The new report finds some AI capabilities still improving exponentially, but models remain weaker at judgment-heavy tasks than at coding.
summary_zh: AI评估非营利组织METR更新了被广泛误读的“时间跨度”图表。新报告发现部分AI能力仍呈指数级提升，但模型在需要判断力的任务上仍不如编程任务表现好。

The latest suggestion being punted about is that, whatever his raw human frailties, Huang is in fact “irreplaceable” as the president of Nvidia. Only this guy can do it. Only this leather-jacketed human visionary, who looks in every available photo like your GCSE chemistry teacher’s profile pic on TerrifiedUkrainianSinglesWantToDateYou.com, can manage this key artificial intelligence mission.
